statement: For every fixed rational delta in (0,1), a deterministic algorithm polynomial in the explicit input length, with exponent depending only on delta, constructs on every undirected unweighted simple n-vertex graph and all integers f>=0,k>=1 an f-vertex-fault-tolerant (C_delta*sqrt(k),C_delta*k)-spanner H subset G with at most C_delta*(f+1)^(1+delta)*n^(1+1/k)*log(n+2)^b_delta edges, simultaneously for every fault set of size at most f and every surviving pair with finite G-F distance. This resolves the complete immutable source.md question under problem.md; the proposed proof, including uniform runtime, is evidence/research3-resolution.md.
contribution: A proposed full uniform polynomial-time realization of the Parter--Popova--Tzalik almost-linear-fault mixed-stretch tradeoff. An f-dependent exact representative-path DP is polynomial in the small-fault regime; the complementary large-fault regime already meets the target via the Dinitz--Robelle multiplicative constructor. The proof verifies insertion-witness packing transfer and all pendant scales. Standard representative-family algebra, protected gap cuts, source packing and multiplicative constructions are credited. No better size/stretch theorem or new representative-family primitive is claimed. Current bounded searches found no equivalent combined method; fresh correctness, novelty, substantive-value and separate STOC review remain required.
